summary: Smart Pricing engine fully tested end-to-end. All 12 existing pytest cases + 4 new HTTP/integration tests pass. Frontend smoke shows the Smart Pricing button renders on vacation cards (9 found), modal opens with Rules/Calendar/Forecast tabs, save persists, 60 calendar day cells render, Apply All visible, Forecast totals visible. Booking-total override integration verified by calling _compute_booking_total directly (the booking API doesn't surface total_price — it's only consumed by the confirmation email).

minor.issue: _compute_booking_total runs and feeds the email, but the computed total is NOT persisted on the booking doc nor returned in any API response. Renters who hit the dashboard see no price detail. Consider persisting total_price on the booking doc and exposing in the response.

issues: Color coding: amber (#fef3c7) for discounts and gray for booked are acceptable, but the green/amber palette assumes light mode only — fine for current app. The 'why' tooltip only shows on hover; on touch devices the reason text is unreachable. Consider expanding factor list inline or via a tap target.
Button uses TrendingUp icon and the 'On' pill renders only when smart_pricing.enabled — visually clear. No issues.

action_items: Consider persisting total_price on the booking document so the API can expose it (currently only feeds the confirmation email).
Optional: on touch devices, expose the per-day 'why' reason without requiring a hover (Calendar tab tooltip).
critical_code_review_comments: smart_pricing.py is well-structured (~680 lines, slightly over 700-line guideline threshold but cohesive — separating the daily cron loop into its own module would help).
compute_suggestion is pure and 100% unit-testable — excellent design choice.
Hebcal cache is process-lifetime — multi-worker deployments will fetch the year once per worker; acceptable for a yearly dataset but worth noting.
_compute_booking_total in bookings.py correctly layers per-night overrides on top of base nightly_price; verified the math matches engine output via direct test.

USD_TO_ILS = 3.7 is a hardcoded constant in smart_pricing.py — for a comparable-median nudge this order-of-magnitude approximation is fine, but a comment explaining why a stale FX is acceptable would help future readers.
Frontend SmartPricingModal: solid use of useCallback/useMemo to avoid effect-thrash on token. data-testid coverage is excellent (every interactive element + each day cell).
No MongoDB _id leakage observed in any of the smart-pricing endpoints.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (modal + 3 tabs + save + 60-day calendar + forecast all verified)

test_credentials: owner@test.com / Test1234! (login flow uses Menu → Login modal, not /login direct route)
seed_data_creation: Each HTTP test creates a temporary vacation property and deletes it in finally — no residual seed data. The test_applied_override_feeds_booking_total test also creates a single confirmed renter booking that is left behind (booking has no delete endpoint surfaced).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Smart Pricing acceptance criteria from the review request verified. The /login page renders the header only (the actual login form lives in a modal opened via the Menu button) — future tests should open the home page, click Menu → Login. The booking API does NOT return total_price; verifying override-total integration requires invoking _compute_booking_total directly (see test_applied_override_feeds_booking_total).
